review: Compared 206 original PNGs against 1311 provider PNGs, basename candidates, small-image similarity and manual visual review. Compared every 80x100 tile in the 14 same-layout character sheets; visually inspected every direction of the active armor2 sheets. Similarity scores alone never authorize removal.

replacements.evidence: Batch3 sprite review: same four circular stations, blue central rotor and front rotor machine family. Parent icon is a newer rendering/state, not byte-identical. Reuse directly; do not generate another copy. PFW directional sheets remain for later frame-specific assessment.
replacements.metadata: All six icon paths use parent image directly at its existing32px size; no entity or recipe alias.

replacements.evidence: All 16 east/west frames match the parent machine and rotating front assembly; the distinct north/south sheet is now also superseded by the owner-selected parent view.
replacements.metadata: All directions of y-factory-4,6,7 use width/height128 and scale0.9375 (120px display extent), shift0.3,0, frame_count16, line_length16 and default speed1. Runtime placement forces north and refuses rotation.

additional_reuse.decision: Owner selected Engines artwork for the displayed view. Subsequent cleanup removes the superseded local sheet; the original remains in the immutable 0.4.15 Git import.
